title: Valid labels for a component
statement: Let $q$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $G$ be a finite unique game with a nonempty finite set of variables and a nonempty finite set of constraint occurrences. Each constraint joins two distinct variables and carries a permutation of the $q$ labels, and every variable occurs in a constraint. For a connected component, the valid labels are the subset of $	ext{Fin}(q)$ consisting of labels for which every constraint whose source lies in that component sends the label transported from its target to the label transported from its source, using the paths from the component representative.
hypotheses_covered: The variable set is finite and nonempty
The constraint-occurrence set is finite and nonempty
Each constraint carries a permutation of the $q$ labels
Every variable occurs in a constraint
